# Rockwoolin - Tungkin Industry Co., Ltd

> > Tungkin Industry Co., Ltd is a China-based manufacturer and supplier of thermal insulation materials including rockwool, glass wool, calcium silicate, and polyester insulation products for industrial and building applications.

Tungkin Industry Co., Ltd specializes in manufacturing and supplying a comprehensive range of insulation materials and thermal solutions. Based in Dongguan, Guangdong, China, the company serves global markets through the HiSupplier platform with products meeting international standards including ASTM-C511 and ASNZS.48591.
